home.metaTitle: SWIMMER PARTY — AI actors who stay the same
home.eyebrow: SWIMMER PARTY · An open roster of AI actors
home.heroBody: {count} original animated actors, each with images, a voice and a character prompt. Use them in films, ads, games, anything, even when you get paid.
home.rosterNote: From Chongqing to Kingston, aged 20 to 75. New faces keep joining.
home.methodNote: Most AI characters change from shot to shot. Ours come with a locked identity pack: the same reference images, voice and character prompt we use in our own films.
home.pipeline.0.title: Casting brief
home.pipeline.0.body: Decide how this person thinks before deciding what they look like. Build it the other way round and the character dies by the third film.
home.pipeline.1.title: Character first
home.pipeline.1.body: Who they are, where they’re from, how they talk. The look follows the person.
home.pipeline.2.title: Real proportions
home.pipeline.2.body: Height, build and adult proportions are fixed before any styling.
home.pipeline.3.title: Identity pack
home.pipeline.3.body: Turnarounds, faces, expressions, wardrobe and voice, all checked against each other.
home.kitNote: An actor becomes worth something by being used. So we hand you the same character seed we use ourselves — paste it into any model and you get this person, not a lookalike. Free, no permission needed.
home.pactNote: Five things we are willing to say in public about who gets paid. Written down so you can hold us to them.
home.stanceBody: Every actor here is animated, and you can tell at a glance. We don’t make photoreal people and we never copy a real one. AI should add new faces to the screen, not take work from the people already on it.
home.worksNote: Our own films first. Then everything you make with them.
home.customBody: We design custom actors for brands and films, built only for you. Or make something with us.
home.castingBody: License a roster actor, commission your own, or co-produce. Three doors, all open. Bring a film, a brand, or just an idea.
roster.metaDescription: Every SWIMMER PARTY AI actor: ready to cast, new faces and in development. Free to use, even commercially. Just credit Swim In AI.
roster.intro: {castable} ready to cast, {newFaces} new faces, {building} in development. Every actor comes with free reference assets.
roster.buildingNote: Character locked, white-model stage. They move to castable the day the plate is delivered.
actor.noPlateBody: This actor is still at the white-model stage. The plate, expression set and wardrobe replace this frame on delivery.
actor.seedEnNote: The seed is written in English on purpose: image models follow English far more reliably than Chinese, whoever you are. Paste it as it is.
works.metaDescription: Films and series starring SWIMMER PARTY’s AI actors, plus work made by the community.
works.intro: Productions starring our own actors. Each one shows its real status.
works.outro: Want one of our actors in your film?
kit.metaDescription: Free character kits for SWIMMER PARTY's AI actors — the character seed, register notes and reference sheets, handed over so anyone can remix them.
kit.intro: A synthetic actor gets valuable the same way a human one does — by being used. So the kit is open. Paste the seed into any image model and you get this person, not a lookalike.
kit.manifestNote: AVAILABLE means the file is on this site now. Everything else is marked by its current status.
kit.seedsNote: Only actors whose look is locked have a seed. An actor still on the white model has no face to describe, so that row says so instead of shipping a guess.
kit.seedPending: No seed yet — still on the white model
kit.rulesNote: Short enough to actually read. Two things you may do freely, three things you must not.
pact.metaDescription: SWIMMER PARTY's public position on who gets paid when a synthetic actor makes money — a draft, published so it can be held to.
pact.intro: Two things, written down where you can hold us to them: what we refuse to build, and how the money gets split when there finally is some. Both were easier to say now, before anyone is arguing about a number.
pact.draftNote: This is a published position, not an executed contract. The settled lines are settled. The percentages are marked open on purpose — we will not print a number we have not honoured yet.
pact.partOneNote: The first half of this page is a refusal. It comes first because it is the one that costs us money.
pact.partTwoNote: The second half is a promise. Work should feed the people who did it. If a character breaks out, that money should not land in one account.
pact.termsTitle: What is settled, what is not
pact.outro: Made something with one of our actors? Send it. That is the whole process.
studio.metaDescription: How SWIMMER PARTY designs AI actors, keeps them consistent and decides who joins the roster.
studio.intro: SWIMMER PARTY is an AI actor project by Pie AI Studio. We design original animated actors, give each one a consistent identity, and cast them in our own films first. Then we open them up to everyone.
studio.beliefsNote: These four decide what everyone on the roster looks like, how they talk, and when they get cut.
studio.beliefs.0.title: A face isn’t a character
studio.beliefs.0.body: Anyone can generate a good face. Keeping it the same person in shot fifty is the real work.
studio.beliefs.1.title: Animated, never photoreal
studio.beliefs.1.body: Our actors are clearly animated. That keeps us honest and leaves human actors’ work to humans.
studio.beliefs.2.title: Open by default
studio.beliefs.2.body: Free for anyone, even for paid work. The more people make things with them, the more they become real characters.
studio.beliefs.3.title: Comedy is the test
studio.beliefs.3.body: Every actor gets tested in comedy. If the timing works, the character works.
studio.stackTitle: Made with AI, checked by people
studio.stackNote: We use current image, voice and video models, chosen for each job. Nothing goes on the site until a person has reviewed it.
studio.stack.0.name: Swimmer UI Kit
studio.stack.0.note: One source for buttons, panels and tokens
studio.stack.1.name: React Three Fiber
studio.stack.2.name: Next.js
studio.stack.2.note: So the roster can actually be found
studio.stack.3.name: PGS
studio.outroBody: We build commissioned actors for brands and films. Designed for you, and never cast by anyone else. Or make something with us.
casting.metaDescription: License a SWIMMER PARTY AI actor for your film, or commission an original one built only for you.
casting.intro: Three routes. Bring nothing but an idea and we will tell you which one you are on.
casting.routes.0.title: License a roster actor
casting.routes.0.body: Use someone already on the roster. Character, expression set and performance range exist today — this is the fast route.
casting.routes.1.title: Commission an actor
casting.routes.1.body: We build a new one for you down the whole line: brief, white model, plate, performance sign-off. Delivered with the full specification sheet.
casting.routes.2.title: Co-produce
casting.routes.2.body: We bring the actors and the production, you bring the subject, the channel or the money. The film belongs to both of us; the character stays on the roster and keeps working.
casting.contactBody: Tell us: what kind of project, roughly when, and which actor you want (or what kind of actor you want). One sentence is fine — we will ask the rest.
casting.availableNote: The castable roster is available now. Commissioned actors are assessed separately.
casting.remixNote: Not a brand, just want to make something? The kit is free and you do not need this page.
notFound.body: This one is not on the roster. Maybe we have not built them yet.
